primary_endpoint: selected-answer final-test pass fraction; all 72 tasks equally weighted
uncertainty: 10000 stratified paired question bootstrap draws, category sizes fixed at 40/16/16; percentile 95% CI
tests: two-sided exact McNemar; Holm correction across four model/contrast p-values
sensitivity: template-cluster bootstrap within category; descriptive category results
precision: resource-constrained fixed cohort; not powered for small effects. Worst-case normal 95% half-width for a single success proportion is about 11.6 pp at n=72, and a paired difference up to 23.1 pp. Six-task pilot does not provide a stable power estimate.
failure_rule: no exclusions; missing/empty/truncated/error/unresolved candidates score failed; final tests never drive recovery
budget: one block, 1024 output tokens per candidate, at most 3 unique requests per task/model (shared first + R + D); 432 total unique request maximum; 120 s request timeout; 1800 s dispatch window per model
scope: fixed two-model finite benchmark comparison; no superiority/equivalence promise or optional stopping
